name: The Weir-Wyrm

passive.name: Slick Hide
passive.text: While it lies in Flooded water it is hard to pin down: +25% evasion.

notes: Warnings: Swallow and Deluge do not hit at once. The marked cells ripple and the attack lands at the start of the Wyrm's next turn, before it acts. Every hero gets at least one turn in between. These hits cannot miss.
Swallow marks a single cell: step out of it (Move) or take a crushing bite.
Surge floods two rows: heroes there are Soaked (fire damage taken ×0.5, Speed ×0.9).
Deluge marks your whole side and has no safe cell: shield, guard, fortify or heal your heroes before it lands.

passives.name: Unyielding
passives.text: Immune to crowd control: Stun, Slow and Silence do not take hold, taunts do not force its attacks, and it cannot be pulled or pushed. Other ailments last 1 turn less.

passives.name: Slick Hide
passives.text: While it lies in Flooded water it gains +25% evasion.

passives.name: Rising Water
passives.text: At 30% HP the Reach rises: its hits deal ×1.15 damage and at once it calls the Deluge. A single attack can cross only one threshold.
